Project Connect - Linking Lenawee with Vital Resources
Lenawee Continuum of Care will host Project Connect on Wednesday, October 28, from 10 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. at the Merchant Building at the Lenawee County Fair & Event Grounds. Read More about
Public Notice of Proposed Lenawee County Materials Management Plan, Public Comment Period and Public
Lenawee County has released its proposed Materials Management Plan for public review and comment. The public comment period will be open from September 2 through November 2, 2026. Read More about
Together We Can: Co-Parenting | Free Online Workshop
Participants will explore ways to work together as parents, better understand children's needs, and develop skills that support healthy family dynamics. Read More about
Positive Discipline: Free Online Parenting Workshop November 17
This workshop will introduce positive discipline techniques that help parents and caregivers guide children's behavior in ways that encourage learning, build self-control, and minimize behavior problems. Read More about
Fraud/Scam Activity Warning
The Lenawee County Sheriff’s Office has received numerous reports of fraudulent activity involving impersonation of members of the Sheriff's Office. Read More about
Caregiver Support Group "Capgras Syndrome"
The Lenawee Department on Aging invites all caregivers to join us for our next Caregiver Support Group on Monday, November 2 at 2:00 PM at Daybreak Adult Day Services, located at 327 Erie Street in Adrian. Read More about
Setting the Stage: Promoting Social-Emotional Health in Young Children
This workshop will explore the importance of social-emotional development and how it contributes to a child's overall brain development, success in school, and ability to form healthy relationships throughout life. Read More about
MSU Extension Offers Free Online Workshop: Talking With Kids About Differences
Michigan State University Extension invites parents and caregivers to participate in Talking With Kids About Differences, a free online workshop offered through the Extension Extras for Parents series on Tuesday, November 10, 2026. Read More about
Blood Drive Coming to the Human Services Building
The American Red Cross will hold a blood drive on Monday, November 16, 2026, at the Lenawee County Human Services Building in Adrian. If you’re able to give, consider rolling up your sleeve and helping provide lifesaving blood for patients in need. Read More about
MDHHS Launches App to Help Residents Quit Tobacco
Michigan adults now have a new tool to help them quit tobacco. The Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) has launched the QuitLogix app, bringing support straight to their phones. Read More about
Men's Caregiver Support Group
It can be hard to be a caregiver, especially if you've never been in this position before in your life. If you are a male Lenawee resident and find yourself caring for an older adult, this support group can help! Read More about
Mental Health First Aid Training Offered in Lenawee County
Much like CPR prepares individuals to respond to a physical emergency, Mental Health First Aid helps people recognize and respond to mental health concerns. Read More about
Notice of Sealed Bids | Used Patrol Vehicles
The Lenawee County Sheriff's Office will be accepting sealed bids for used patrol vehicles. Read More about
Notice of Early Voting Precinct and Hours General Election
All qualified electors in the aforementioned municipalities have the right to mark a ballot and deposit the ballot in a tabulator beginning the second Saturday before an election and ending the Sunday before the election. Read More about
Trick-or-Treat with Lenawee County at Our Trunk or Treat!
Lenawee County invites families from across the community to join us for a Trunk or Treat on Thursday, October 29, from 5:00 to 6:00 PM in the north parking lot of the Lenawee County Judicial Building. Read More about
You’re Invited: 2026 Fall Legislative Dinner
Lenawee County invites you to join us for the 2026 Fall Legislative Dinner on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at the LISD Tech Center, 1372 N. Main Street, Adrian. Read More about
MSU Extension to Offer “Guiding Principles for Highly Successful Parenting” Webinar Series
Looking for practical parenting tools that grow with your family? MSU Extension’s “Guiding Principles for Highly Successful Parenting” webinar series offers strategies to build routines, strengthen relationships, and support your child’s success. Read More about
Lenawee County Nonprofits Invited to Consumers Energy Resource Roundtable
The roundtable will give local nonprofit organizations an opportunity to learn more about resources available through Consumers Energy that may benefit their organizations and the individuals and families they serve. Read More about
Scam Awareness Presentations Coming to Lenawee Senior Centers
The Lenawee County Department on Aging is highlighting several upcoming scam awareness presentations at local senior centers to help residents protect their money and personal information. Read More about
Notice of Nominations for Veterans Affairs Executive Committee
The Lenawee County Department of Veterans Affairs is seeking nominations for the appointment of a veteran to serve on its Executive Committee for a four-year term ending December 31, 2030. Read More about
How Children Develop: Free Online Workshop for Early Childhood Professionals
During the workshop, participants will explore active learning, child developmental domains and characteristics of typical development. Read More about
Positive Discipline Webinar Helps Parents Build Self-Control and Reduce Behavior Challenges
This webinar is part of MSU Extension's Extension Extras for Parents series, a free online program designed to provide guidance for parents as they navigate the challenges, joys, and concerns of raising children. Read More about
Drive-Thru Drug Take-Back Day – Fall 2026
Safely dispose of your unused, unwanted, or expired medications this fall at the Drive-Thru Drug Take-Back Day hosted at Promedica Hickman Hospital. Read More about
Explore Your Parenting Style with MSU Extension
MSU Extension will offer “Exploring Parenting Styles” on Tuesday, October 27, from 7:30 to 9 p.m. This free online workshop gives parents and caregivers an opportunity to explore different parenting styles and consider what works best for their family. Read More about
Free Programs Available Through Consumers Energy
Lenawee County residents have access to two great energy-saving programs through Consumers Energy. Both programs support homeowners and renters and include assistance to mobile homes. Read More about
Housing Lenawee to Host 2026 Housing Solutions Conference
Discussions will focus on topics such as proven solutions to housing challenges, resources available to support new construction, workforce housing, housing policy, and opportunities for greater collaboration. Read More about
Project Connect - Linking Lenawee with Vital Resources
Lenawee Continuum of Care will host Project Connect on Wednesday, October 28, from 10 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. at the Merchant Building at the Lenawee County Fair & Event Grounds. Read More about

Docket to Drive
Docket to Drive is changing how participants view the judicial system. Instead of seeing it as something working against them, many begin to see it as a partner in helping them move forward.
Building Families Through Adoption in Lenawee County
Here in Lenawee County, dozens of families open their hearts every year, each adoption adding another thread to the fabric of our community.
Lenawee County Veterans Received $89 Million in VA Related Benefits Last Year
During the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) provided a total of $89,131,162 in benefits and services to 5,951 veterans residing in Lenawee County.
Lenawee Foster Youth Holiday Drive Brings Joy to Children
This year, the holiday spirit reached new heights with a significant contribution from the construction managers and subcontractors involved in the ongoing renovation and expansion project at Maurice Spear Campus.
The Lenawee County Airport: A Vital Economic Engine for Adrian, MI, and Beyond
The Lenawee County Airport is more than a regional transportation hub; it’s a cornerstone of economic vitality for Adrian and the surrounding areas. The recent MDOT report underscores its significant contributions to job creation, income generation, and economic activity.

Access to clean and safe water is something we often take for granted. It is vital for drinking, recreation, sanitation, hygiene, industry, and agriculture.
